summary: RPCS3 Core 907 = Core 906 plus two GPU levers for Assassin's Creed (IPA 676: 25-28 fps in play, ~30 ms of GPU work per frame, 44-48 render passes per frame all LOAD/STORE). (1) REWINDBOX_LOAD_OP_CLEAR_907: a full-framebuffer fast clear that begins a render pass now begins it with load-op CLEAR for exactly the cleared attachments, instead of loading the old image from memory and then drawing the clear over it (MoltenVK executes vkCmdClearAttachments as a draw); same result. (2) REWINDBOX_NATIVE_HALF_907: the fragment decompilers give the RSX half-precision H registers native float16 types, as the RSX computes them, keeping every other High-precision rule. Both are per-title settings, Automatic on for Assassin's Creed only. Core 906 = retired overrides skipped, timed Metal report. ABI 30, the 92 exports and the PPU/SPU codegen identities unchanged. Not built, no iPhone run.
